name: PHANTASMAGORIA
source:
A short visual novel/point and click game about a man living with this being named Toolbox. 

Throughout the entire game you will have to interact with Toolbox, with given choices.

Who knows where those choices may lead you?

[From [url=https://lobotomizedrick.itch.io/phantasmagoria]itch.io[/url]]
